name: Happy Path — PRA Annual Stress Test Exercise
description: CRO initiates annual PRA stress test. Scenarios loaded into risk engine. Projections run and validated. Board approves. CRO confirms PRA submission via BEEDS portal.

steps.action: POST /stress-tests {exercise_year: 2026, pra_scenario_version: ACS-2026-v1.0, scenario_type: severe_adverse, pra_deadline: 2026-07-31}
Create StressTestExercise (ENT-073) status=in_progress; load PRA scenarios into model parameters
Publish StressTestExerciseStarted (EVT-161)
Consume EVT-161 → Create RegulatorySubmission (ENT-074) status=pending; deadline=2026-07-31
Consume EVT-161 → Write immutable exercise start record
201 Created {exercise_id, status: in_progress}
Run credit risk projections (IFRS 9 ECL under stress) — batch job < 24h
Run market risk projections (FRTB stressed losses)
Run OpRisk Basel SA capital calculation
Compute projected stressed CET1 Y1/Y2/Y3; update StressTestExercise status=projections_complete
GET /stress-tests/{exercise_id} — review projections
200 OK {projected_cet1_y1: 12.4%, y2: 10.8%, y3: 11.2%, model_validation_sign_off_ref}
Board Risk Committee reviews projections; CRO obtains Board approval; PATCH status → approved_for_submission
Update StressTestExercise status=approved_for_submission; record board_approved_at, cro_attestation_ref
POST /stress-tests/{exercise_id}/confirm-submission {pra_submission_ref: BEEDS-2026-XXXX, cro_attestation_ref}
Update StressTestExercise status=submitted; record pra_submission_ref and submitted_at
Publish StressTestSubmitted (EVT-162) {pra_submission_ref, stressed_cet1_trajectory}
Consume EVT-162 → Update RegulatorySubmission status=submitted; record submission_ref
Consume EVT-162 → Write immutable PRA submission record
200 OK {status: submitted, pra_submission_ref}
